meaning:
§ Zaanannim or Zaanaim = "removings"
a place in Naphtali near Kedesh

elsewhere.note: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.
Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites, even from the children of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law, and had pitched his tent as far as the oak…
